packages.title: USS Midway Museum — Preferred Lodging Partnership
packages.summaryWhat: Waterfront museum venue with published evening private-event program and no on-site lodging — complementary overnight for North Harbor / Embarcadero hotels.
packages.whyNow: Official Midway evening-events program (6–10 p.m.) advertises Flight/Hangar decks for recurring private functions; lodging referral relationship is ongoing, not a single dated room block.
packages.whyThisMatters: Wyndham San Diego Bayside (1355 N Harbor Drive) sits in the same North Harbor / Embarcadero corridor as Midway. Venue guests need nearby overnight rooms; Midway's published F&B partners are competing hotels for catering, not exclusive lodging — leaving a referral opening for a bayfront hotel.
packages.recommendedAction: Use Midway's evening-events inquiry path to ask how planners currently source overnight lodging and whether Wyndham Bayside can be listed as a nearby option.
packages.partnerResearchScope: Reviewed Midway evening-events page and food-beverage partner page (2026-10-14/15). Catering partners named (Manchester Grand Hyatt, Marriott Marquis); no exclusive preferred-lodging partner published. Scope ≠ proof that no private lodging relationships exist.

activityEvidence.evidenceText: Official evening-events page: Hangar/Flight decks available 6–10 p.m. for corporate, military, nonprofit, and social events; capacity 300–3,500; walking distance to convention center and adjacent hotels.
Published F&B partners include Manchester Grand Hyatt and Marriott Marquis (catering — not exclusive lodging).

packages.title: Embarcadero Marina Park South — Preferred Lodging Partnership
packages.summaryWhat: Port waterfront park next to the Convention Center with no lodging — permit-driven private gatherings create complementary overnight demand for bayfront hotels.
packages.whyNow: Port of San Diego publishes park permitting for organized gatherings; EMPS is a standing venue account (permit-driven), not a single dated citywide room block.
packages.whyThisMatters: Embarcadero Marina Park South sits on the downtown waterfront corridor with Wyndham San Diego Bayside. Permitted private/corporate gatherings have no on-site rooms; Hilton Bayfront has used EMPS for events (public CEQA notice) — complementary overnight opportunity remains for other bayfront hotels.
packages.recommendedAction: Email parkpermits@portofsandiego.org to ask which organizers repeatedly host EMPS events needing downtown lodging and whether Wyndham Bayside can be offered as a nearby option.
packages.partnerResearchScope: Reviewed Port EMPS page and park permitting page (2026-10-14/15). No exclusive preferred hotel partner published for EMPS private gatherings. Scope ≠ proof that no organizer–hotel relationships exist.

packages.title: Anderson House — Preferred Lodging Partnership

packages.whyNow: Society of the Cincinnati publishes ongoing site rentals (corporate/personal evenings and weddings) with named Events Manager contact; standing partnership opportunity, not a dated room block.

packages.recommendedAction: Email Joanne Blanco (Events Manager) to introduce Mayflower as a Connecticut Ave / Farragut overnight option for Anderson House private-event guests and ask about preferred lodging referral language.
packages.partnerResearchScope: Reviewed Anderson House site-rentals overview and corporate/personal events pages (2026-10-15). Three nearby hotels named for parking/lodging proximity; Mayflower not listed. Scope covers public pages only — not proof no private preferred-hotel arrangements exist.
